Use exact sections when practical.

## Source verification

For a source used by a ready route:

- [ ] canonical URL checked
- [ ] exact chapter/section/lecture/assignment locator checked
- [ ] source role is clear
- [ ] `last_checked` and review interval are updated where needed

## Evidence contract

- diagnostic;
- practice;
- exit evidence;
- transfer/review/applied evidence where required.

## Project impact

If the route targets `applied`, which reference project and milestone provide integration evidence?

## Validation

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] generated curriculum status is current
- [ ] internal links resolve

What simpler alternative was considered?
